cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Breakfast first; I've got today under control. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just started eating together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rent is covered; I put my own money in. I'll make fresh toast, however you like it. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open the letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After breakfast. You choose how long we sit; I'll clear everything. Yesterday you finally unpacked. Let me keep this morning together before we put another thing between us.
